players.product: two Project Suncatcher TPU prototype satellites for Google and Pelican satellites integrating NVIDIA IGX Thor on-orbit compute

quarterly_data.signal: Planet 10-K: in October 2025 Planet entered an agreement with Google (a related party) to provide research and development services testing the viability and performance of a payload integrated on prototype satellites (the Google R&D Services Agreement); Planet recognized $0.4 million of funding in the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 and, as of that date, had received a total of $5.0 million of funding under the agreement.

Planet 10-K: Planet recorded $26.0 million of expense in the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 for hosting and other services provided by Google, and has minimum purchase commitments for Google hosting services through January 31, 2028 totaling $67,480 thousand.
